Power: 9-18 volt neg. center pin ONLY. Current draw: 11mA @ 9v. The Lightspeed Organic Overdrive is a very natural sounding overdrive. Why "organic"? Well, simply put, it's the clearest, most natural feeling, and best overdrive we've heard for the player looking for a natural drive tone. Blending with the tone of the guitar and amplifier, this pedal has rich harmonics and complex but smooth clipping. The Lightspeed Overdrive is sensitive to pick attack and has a different "feel" than other overdrives. The Lightspeed can be set to be "transparent," but can also drive your signal to the edge. On tour with Peter Stroud (Sheryl Crow, and others), Alex Weeden (Miranda Lambert), Drew Shirley (Switchfoot), J.B. Brisendine (Brother Hawk), Casey Meyer (Jim Quick and Coastline), Jason "JJ Boogie" Reichert (Arrested Development), James Duke, Matt Goldman (Glow in the Dark Studios), JR Mead (Kutless), Jordan Peters (Lauryn Hill), and more! Natural light to mild overdrive! Rich harmonics, smooth clipping! Can be set to sound like original signal (what some call "transparent")! True Bypass! Uses 9-Volt battery or standard neg. center, 2.1mm power supply. Built with top quality component 5-year to the original owner! sources.excerpt: Greer Amps Lightspeed Organic Overdrive - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Greer Amps Lightspeed Organic Overdrive Posted By Pedal of the Day on Sunday, June 22, 2025 in Greer Amps, Overdrive / Distortion | 0 comments --> --> This isn’t the first time we’ve encountered today’s pedal, the Lightspeed Organic Overdrive from Greer Amps . This gorgeous pedal first appeared on the scene over a decade ago, and has over time become a go-to for many players , from many genres, across the globe. The kind of pedal you just know is gonna be special right when you plug it in, the Lightspeed will jump through audio hyperspace in no time flat… Shop Greer Amps at Amazon https://amzn.to/4jl9wdh The Lightspeed Organic Overdrive is a very natural sounding overdrive . Why “organic”? Well, simply put, it’s one of the clearest, most natural feeling, and best overdrives on the market, designed for players looking for a natural drive tone. Blending with the tone of the guitar and amplifier, this pedal has rich harmonics and complex but smooth clipping. The Lightspeed Overdrive is sensitive to pick attack and has a different “feel” than other overdrives. It can be set to be “transparent,” but can also drive your signal to the edge. Available in a multitude of different color variations, the Lightspeed Organic Overdrive becomes a staple unit on almost every pedalboard it gets added to. Filled with that certain sparkle and magic you can’t quite put your finger on, it shapes your overall sound perfectly, no matter what type of music you might be playing. I had a great time demoing this one again, as you’ll see and hear in the video below – be sure to subscribe, leave a comment and hit that thumb’s up while you watch, cheers!!
